title: Make orbit helper render active illumination trio
objective: Update the orbit workflow helper so one render command produces exactly the three requested lighting conditions: scene lighting with no co-located light, no scene lighting with co-located light, and scene lighting with co-located light.
instructions: User requested: 'At each render I want - scene lighting with no co-located, no scene lighting with co-located and scene-lighting with co-located.'
Preserve the existing teleop helper behavior.

Update examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh so the default render workflow produces three clearly named output directories/videos: scene_on_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, and scene_on_flashlight_on, or equivalent unambiguous names.

Because scene-light intensity scale is launch-time state, implement render as two run_orbit_collection.py render invocations if needed: one with scene-light scale set to the configured value for scene-on outputs, and one with scene-light scale 0.0 or --disable-scene-lights for scene-off/co-located output.
Keep fixed exposure explicit with --disable-auto-exposure for all render invocations.
Keep user override for scene-on scale via --scene-light-intensity-scale or SPEAR_SCENE_LIGHT_INTENSITY_SCALE; scene-off should remain fully off independent of that configured scene-on scale.
Use temporary light-settings JSON files if simpler, but keep checked-in JSON/docs aligned. Avoid requiring users to hand-write JSON.
Update examples/flashlight/README.md and docs/running_our_example_applications.md to explain the three-condition render output and commands.

Add/update tests where lightweight and relevant, especially validation of checked-in JSON if changed. Run shell syntax checks, helper --help checks in spear-env, JSON validation, and existing orbit validation tests.
constraints: No Git operations and no commits.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with changed files, exact commands, output paths, tests run, and any limitations.
definition_of_done: After saving an orbit JSON, Running: python examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py --mode render --map-path /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.2 --intensity 1500 --attenuation-radius 450 --inner-cone-angle 8 --outer-cone-angle 20 --indirect-lighting-intensity 0 --orbit-spec-file examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json --light-settings-file examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json --output-dir examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output produces the three requested lighting-condition videos without manual JSON editing.
